hero.kicker: Postdoctoral Researcher · Computational Biology & AI for Drug Discovery
hero.statement: I develop machine-learning methods that bring chemical knowledge — conformations, pharmacophores, and molecular interactions — into molecular representation and drug design. My work spans small-molecule discovery and protein–ligand, protein–protein, and RNA–ligand interaction modeling, with emerging directions in phenotype-based and multi-target drug design.
hero.affiliationHtml: Postdoctoral Researcher, Institute of Systems Medicine, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences (Suzhou) · Supervised by Prof. Yang Zhang (NUS) · Ph.D., ShanghaiTech University (Prof. Fang Bai)
hero.statAwardNote: GeminiMol team · GluN1/GluN3A NAM GM-10 (Acta Pharmacol. Sin. 2025)

program.title: Research Program
program.lead: Integrating 3D conformational ensembles, pharmacophore geometry, biomolecular interfaces, and cellular phenotypes into generalizable AI models for medicinal chemistry.
program.moleculesText: Chemically grounded foundation models capturing conformational space, pharmacophores, and synthetic accessibility across small molecules and emerging cyclic peptides.
program.interactionsText: Structure- and motif-driven modeling of molecular-glue recruitment interfaces, chemical priors in SBDD, protein conformational ensembles, and nucleotide-level RNA pockets.
program.phenotypesText: Multi-conformational similarity navigation and multimodal phenotypic representations connecting chemical structure directly to cellular response and dual-target lead discovery.

monograph.meta: Featured Research Line · GeminiMol (Adv. Sci. 2024) → Ouroboros (Adv. Sci. 2026) · First Author · Open Code & Weights
monograph.title: Conformational-Space Foundation & Ouroboros Orthogonal Architecture
monograph.deck: Across GeminiMol and Ouroboros, we advance two distinct pillars for medicinal chemistry: (1) a conformational-space representation foundation encoding 3D ensembles and pharmacophore geometry to recognize cross-scaffold functional equivalence; and (2) architectural orthogonality in Ouroboros, where representation pretraining, downstream property predictors, and SMILES reconstruction train independently and compose freely at inference time for screening and directed lead optimization.
monograph.zoomHint: Click any figure to inspect high-resolution plate
monograph.fig1Alt: GeminiMol and Ouroboros conformational-space representation lineage and experimental validations
monograph.fig1Caption: Figure 1. Conformational-space representation lineage from GeminiMol (pairwise CSS/MCS contrastive pretraining; GluN1/GluN3A NAM GM-10, 0.98 μM, 1st/142 teams) to Ouroboros (matrix-based similarity learning; Pictilisib + AT-9283 multi-conformational screening of 48.2M Enamine compounds yielding AURKA/PI3K Compound #13).
monograph.p1n1Text: Flexible drugs such as Imatinib adopt distinct 3D conformations to engage multiple targets (NMOR2, ABL, DDR1, PPARG). Encoding conformational ensembles and pharmacophores overcomes 2D fingerprint blindness.
monograph.p1n2Title: From pairwise CSS to similarity-matrix alignment
monograph.p1n2Text: GeminiMol pioneered pairwise contrastive pretraining on conformational-space (CSS) and MCS similarity; Ouroboros scales this to full batch similarity-matrix MSE alignment across conformations, pharmacophores, and fingerprints.
monograph.p1n3Text: GeminiMol discovered scaffold-distinct GluN1/GluN3A NAM GM-10 (0.98 μM; 1st/142 teams). Ouroboros navigated 48.2M Enamine compounds via Pictilisib + AT-9283 profiles to uncover multi-target Compound #13.
monograph.p1n3Evidence: Compound #13: AURKA 0.42 μM · PI3Kγ 1.74 μM · PI3Kα 8.05 μM
monograph.archAAlt: Comparison of per-task fine-tuning versus Ouroboros frozen representation projection
monograph.archACaption: One frozen representation module projects cleanly to arbitrarily many independent predictors, avoiding per-task encoder fine-tuning.
monograph.archBAlt: Ouroboros independent Transformer decoder and token projector for SMILES reconstruction
monograph.archBCaption: Trained completely independently of downstream predictors, decoding frozen (1, H) embeddings into molecular SMILES via a Transformer decoder.
monograph.archCLabel: C · Free Composition for Closed-Loop Iterative Vector Optimization
monograph.archCAlt: Ouroboros composable closed-loop iterative vector optimization diagram
monograph.archCCaption: At inference time, freely combine any trained property predictors (QSAR, ADME/Tox, Similarity, SA) to iteratively steer a molecule's latent vector and decode optimized candidates without retraining.
monograph.p2n1Title: Train once, project across all tasks
monograph.p2n1Text: Unlike end-to-end fine-tuning that forks encoder weights for every assay, Ouroboros keeps one frozen chemical representation while lightweight predictors train independently on each property.
monograph.p2n2Text: The Transformer Decoder and Token Projector train solely to invert the frozen embedding back to SMILES, cleanly separating molecular generation capacity from assay-specific data scarcity.
monograph.p2n3Text: Because predictors and reconstructor share the exact same frozen coordinates, any subset of QSAR, ADME/Tox, similarity, or SA models can be plugged in on the fly to steer hit vectors into new leads.
monograph.fig3Alt: Three-stage Ouroboros drug discovery workflow from pharmacological hypothesis to hit discovery and hit-to-lead optimization
monograph.fig3Caption: Figure 3. End-to-end Ouroboros drug discovery paradigm spanning (1) Pharmacological Hypothesis formulation across property and polypharmacology spaces, (2) Hit Discovery via multimodal representation and navigation modules over commercial chemical libraries, and (3) closed-loop Hit-to-Lead Optimization via iterative representation vector updates and decoupled Transformer SMILES reconstruction.
monograph.p3n1Text: Translates intra-family, inter-family, and biased-signaling hypotheses—grounded in reference molecules, omics regulation, cell response, and ADMET—into intersecting target and property subspaces.
monograph.p3n2Text: Fuses conformational space, phenotype, knowledge priors, and chemical language to drive navigation modules (QSAR, ADME/Tox, similarity, SA, safety/kinome, DTI) across commercial chemical space.
monograph.p3n3Text: Iteratively updates a hit's 1D representation vector toward multi-objective profiles and decodes novel leads via a Transformer + Token Projector trained over a wider reconstruction chemical space.

portfolio.title: Algorithms, Benchmarks & Validated Discoveries
portfolio.subtitle: Representative frameworks and applied discoveries spanning molecular representation, biomolecular interactions, phenotypic modeling, and computational biology & drug discovery.
portfolio.ouroborosFigAlt: Ouroboros conformational-space representation and reconstruction figure
portfolio.ouroborosFigCaption: Ouroboros: orthogonal conformational-space representation and SMILES reconstruction engine enabling multi-target AURKA/PI3K discovery (Compound #13).
portfolio.ouroborosDesc: Orthogonal molecular foundation framework decoupling similarity-matrix representation pretraining, independent property predictors, and Transformer SMILES reconstruction so modules compose freely for screening and directed lead optimization.
portfolio.ouroborosH1: Multi-conformational screening of 48.2M Enamine compounds from Pictilisib + AT-9283 profiles.
portfolio.ouroborosH2: Compound #13 validated with AURKA IC₅₀ = 0.42 μM, PI3Kγ = 1.74 μM, and PI3Kα = 8.05 μM.
portfolio.cocobindFigAlt: CoCoBind RNA-ligand interaction and nucleotide binding-site prediction workflow
portfolio.cocobindFigCaption: CoCoBind: consistency-contrastive multitask framework coupling RNA sequence and small-molecule SMILES representations to predict both global interaction probability P(interaction) and nucleotide-level binding sites P(site_i).
portfolio.cocobindDesc: Consistency-contrastive multitask learning combining molecular conformation and RNA language representations for joint RNA–ligand interaction scoring and nucleotide-level binding-site identification.
portfolio.cocobindH1: Jointly predicts RNA–small-molecule binding probability P(interaction) and residue-level pocket probabilities P(siteᵢ) from RNA sequence and Drug SMILES.
portfolio.cocobindH2: Aligns conformational chemical priors with RNA language representations for interpretable RNA-targeted drug discovery.
portfolio.geminimolFigAlt: GeminiMol WLN graph encoder and contrastive pretraining diagram
portfolio.geminimolFigCaption: GeminiMol: pairwise contrastive WLN graph encoder pretrained on conformational-space similarity (CSS) and maximum common substructure (MCS).
portfolio.geminimolDesc: Contrastive WLN graph encoder pretrained on conformational-space similarity (CSS) and maximum common substructure (MCS), capturing 3D functional equivalence across scaffolds for zero-shot ligand-based and phenotypic virtual screening.
portfolio.geminimolH1: Outperforms classical 2D fingerprints on scaffold-hopping benchmarks, target identification, and ADMET/phenotypic property prediction.
portfolio.geminimolH2: Led GeminiMol team to 1st Place / 142 teams in the inaugural Shanghai International Computational Biology Competition.
portfolio.gm10FigAlt: GeminiMol ligand-similarity discovery of GluN1/GluN3A inhibitor GM-10
portfolio.gm10FigCaption: Ligand-similarity virtual screening of 18M compounds using GeminiMol from WZB117 (IC50 = 1.17 μM), yielding scaffold-distinct GluN1/GluN3A NAM GM-10 (IC50 = 0.98 ± 0.13 μM).
portfolio.gm10Desc: Prospective ligand-similarity drug screening campaign applying GeminiMol to an 18M-compound commercial library from reference modulator WZB117 to discover a structurally novel GluN1/GluN3A NMDA receptor negative allosteric modulator.
portfolio.gm10H1: Whole-cell patch-clamp electrophysiology validated hit GM-10 with IC₅₀ = 0.98 ± 0.13 μM against GluN1/GluN3A.
portfolio.gm10H2: Achieved true scaffold hopping: 2D fingerprint similarities all < 0.21 vs. GeminiMol similarity 0.678.
portfolio.mcr1FigAlt: MCR-1 transmembrane, linker, and catalytic domain Lipid A interaction and free-energy landscape
portfolio.mcr1FigCaption: MCR-1 full-length structural modeling and MD free-energy landscape analysis mapping transmembrane, linker, and catalytic domains alongside Lipid A substrate recognition residues.
portfolio.mcr1Desc: Full-length membrane structural modeling and molecular dynamics simulations elucidated how a novel MCR-1 variant mediates Lipid A recognition and colistin/β-lactam co-resistance while revealing a candidate antimicrobial peptide.
portfolio.mcr1H1: Mapped Lipid A binding across MCR-1 transmembrane, linker, and catalytic domains (K204, K211, R190, Y200) and conformational free-energy landscapes.
portfolio.mcr1H2: Explained cross-resistance phenotypes and identified a derivative peptide with potent antimicrobial activity.
portfolio.ppiminerFigAlt: PPI-Miner CRBN molecular glue degron mining figure
portfolio.ppiminerFigCaption: PPI-Miner proteome-wide CRBN G-loop degron mining (1,739 candidates; ≥12 prospective hits independently validated in Science, 2025).
portfolio.ppiminerDesc: Structure- and sequence-motif co-driven mining engine that identifies receptor-compatible binding interfaces across sequence-divergent proteins, with dedicated workflows for CRBN β-hairpin G-loop molecular-glue neosubstrates.
portfolio.ppiminerH1: Proteome-wide CRBN scan identified 1,739 G30 candidates and recovered 16 previously reported substrates.
portfolio.ppiminerH2: Retrospective cross-check with Petzold et al. (Science, 2025) confirmed ≥12 additional released-library hits (WEE1, SCYL1, CSNK1D, etc.).
portfolio.ledgerHeading: Additional Core Methods, Benchmarks & Drug Discovery Studies
portfolio.sbddDesc: Incorporating explicit medicinal-chemistry priors and physical laws into 3D structure-based drug design models to curb geometric hallucinations and improve synthetic realism.
portfolio.conformersDesc: Comprehensive benchmark systematically evaluating deep generative models on capturing multi-state protein conformational landscape diversity and physical plausibility.
portfolio.hurDesc: Discovery and structural-mechanistic characterization of small-molecule molecular glue degraders targeting the RNA-binding protein HuR to suppress BRAF-mutant colorectal cancer.
portfolio.phenomodelDesc: Multimodal phenotypic drug design foundation model aligning molecular structure with cell-painting morphology and transcriptomic signatures to discover novel cancer-cell inhibitors.
portfolio.ho1Desc: Structure-guided design and computational modeling of an NADPH-independent fluorescent chemical probe enabling selective live-cell imaging of heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1).
portfolio.mcr3Desc: Integrated structural modeling, epidemiological surveillance, and functional analysis clarifying the molecular determinants and evolutionary fitness costs of mobilised colistin resistance gene mcr-3.
portfolio.deepsaDesc: Deep learning frameworks evaluating synthetic accessibility across drug-like small molecules (DeepSA) and heterobifunctional PROTAC degraders (DeepPSA).
portfolio.propofolDesc: Computational target engagement modeling and mechanistic investigation revealing that propofol exerts rapid anti-anhedonia effects by inhibiting the dopamine transporter (DAT).
portfolio.spikeDesc: Molecular dynamics simulations and structure-based virtual screening uncovered allosteric inhibition mechanisms and small-molecule entry blockers targeting the SARS-CoV-2 spike glycoprotein.
portfolio.mproDesc: Structure-assisted virtual screening and biochemical validation identifying covalent and repurposed inhibitors (including Ebselen and N3) against the SARS-CoV-2 main protease Mpro.

tools.title: Open-Source Tools & Scripts
tools.subtitle: Standalone software utilities, simulation automation pipelines, and biomedical database navigators built for day-to-day CADD and structural biology workflows beyond formal publications.
tools.cadd: Curated shell and Python automation scripts for large-scale virtual screening, cross-docking, ligand preparation, and protein modeling with Schrödinger and Rosetta.
tools.automd: Automated Desmond molecular dynamics system setup and simulation pipeline (AutoMD) coupled with configurable trajectory clustering, interface contact mapping, and free-energy landscape analysis (AutoTRJ).
tools.biodb: Lightweight browser-based navigator dispatching one query seamlessly across multiple biomedical, chemical, sequence, and structural biology databases from a single interface.
